Name: Ravensdale
Overview:
Ravensdale is an Action Adventure game, developed and published by Spellbound, which was cancelled before it was released.

Ravensdale is a fast paced fantasy action game in a very unique steam powered setting featuring outrageously over-powered gadgetry. The player will seek out high pressure steam outlets, to supercharge his equipment, allowing him to pulverize his adversaries and overcome the obstacles on his path.
